title: Baxter Deployment Config
description: Formal schema for deployment.yaml (framework §8.2). Structure is enforced by this schema; semantic cross-field rules are listed in `x-semantics` and validated by Baxter before any approval gate. Generated by the Onboarding Protocol (§8.6); validated again by Enumerate (§8.4 step 1).

name.description: Deployment identifier; must match the directory name under deployments/.

business_context.description: Path to business-context.md, relative to the deployment directory; loaded into long-term memory (§7.3).

provider.description: memory-service is the only portable choice (§7.5 rule 2); harness-native is opt-in and lossy.

location.description: Store path or connection string; must be inside core Data Storage so §7.1 covers it.

oneOf.description: YAML 1.1 parsers read bare `off` as boolean false — accepted as equivalent.

embeddings.description: Default off; a later upgrade behind the same recall API (§7.5).

name.description: Connector identifier; must match a Connector Pack in connectors/. Known packs: website, crm, email-marketing, social, accounting.

system_of_record.description: Exactly one connector per deployment may be true (§5 rule 3).

connection.description: Chosen once per connector, never per deployment (§5 rule 5).

connector_pack.description: Path to the Connector Pack document.

secrets.description: Vault path reference — NEVER a value (§7.4).

scopes.description: Connector names this role may touch (§4.1). Typically [email-marketing, social].
Typically [crm] (create contacts only) plus the customer_chat channel.

owner.description: Verified identity of the owner on the messaging channel.

staff.description: Verified identities of staff Messaging Channel users.

customer_chat.description: Customer chat endpoints (website widget / WhatsApp). Empty = not activated.

what.description: Short machine-friendly description of the sync, e.g. new_contact_syncs_to_tagged_list.

sync_topology.description: Declared, never guessed (§8.5 rule 4). Every from/to must name a connector in `connectors`.

default.description: Named approver from channels.approvers — the owner by default; never an unenrolled identity.

backup.description: Where the config workspace is backed up (framework §7.2 rule 4, §8.2). Asked during onboarding working rules; configured during setup.

mode.description: private-remote: workspace commits push to the owner's private git repository. local-only: config stays on the agent — Baxter must warn the owner that agent-level backup must cover it.

remote.description: Git remote URL for private-remote mode. Never a public repository. Absent for local-only.

x-semantics: S1: connectors[].name values are unique; every name matches a Connector Pack file present in connectors/.
S2: exactly one connector has system_of_record: true (§5 rule 3).
S3: roles.<role>.scopes reference only names present in connectors (§4.1).

S4: roles.content may be active only if the deployment includes a content-relevant connector (email-marketing or social); roles.operations only with crm or accounting; roles.customer_engagement only if channels.customer_chat is non-empty (§4.1 activation table).
S5: memory.namespaces for a specialist may be enabled only if that role is active; coordinator is always enabled.
S6: sync_topology.from and sync_topology.to reference connectors present in `connectors`; no self-loops.
S7: approval_gates.default maps to a key in channels.approvers (owner or an enrolled staff identity).
S8: secrets paths are syntactically valid vault references and are validated against the vault early in setup so a missing credential fails at Learn, not mid-Apply (§8.2).
S10: no secret values anywhere in the file — vault paths only (§7.4 rule 3).
S11: backup.mode = private-remote requires backup.remote to be present; backup.remote is forbidden for local-only mode; the remote must never point at a public repository (§7.2 rule 4).
